itihasa_bhagavad_gita_chapter13_verse2.title: Bhagavad Gita Chapter 13 Verse 2
itihasa_bhagavad_gita_chapter13_verse2.introduction: This verse belongs to Chapter 13 of the Bhagavad Gita.
itihasa_bhagavad_gita_chapter13_verse2.scripture_text: Bhagavad Gita Chapter 13, Verse 2 teaches disciplined action, inner clarity, and devotion to the Divine as a path to liberation.
